statement: Public use of illegal drugs should be banned in BC.
change_reason: Split two-idea statement; kept the public-use ban only.

statement: It should be harder for repeat violent offenders to be released on bail.
The province should expand involuntary care for people with severe addiction and mental illness.
Funding for police should be increased to address street disorder.
The province should scale back safer-supply programs that give drug users alternatives to street drugs.
change_reason: Removed second idea (shift to treatment); defined safer supply for casual readers.

statement: BC should create many more publicly funded treatment and recovery beds.
Municipalities should be allowed to ban public drug use in their own bylaws.
Courts should be able to order addiction treatment for repeat offenders.
BC should spend more on youth programs intended to prevent crime.
change_reason: Removed 'and' join of two program ideas; single clearer statement.
